method: Actual same-time production scene. Only the receiver getter is filtered; cloud/source getters retain the same full scene. Opaque pre-temporal RGBA16F sampled into RGBA32F and normalized by each capture storage 2^P. Light diagnostics describe shared receiver-source records; native scene participation is not inferred from a PointLight mirror.
limits: A and B are recompressed independently. Their sum is compared with normal AB as spatial approximation error, never claimed strictly linear.
Strict GPU superposition holds all normal AB proxy positions/radii/colours fixed and isolates each proxy without recompression.
Sand uses source-centre-UV depth/terrain agreement; vegetation mask includes leaves, branches and trunks; water uses the production alpha tag.
Sparse lifecycle snapshots establish sampled receiver coverage; natural continuity needs the separate per-rendered-frame probe.
No calibrated lux, subjective sound/appearance acceptance, FPS claim, or physical-time rewind.
